tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the changelog and readme to understand what Jalmus is (a music notation trainer), its version history, and supported languages.

tour.title: Application Entry Point
tour.description: Jalmus.java is the Main-Class entry point: it builds the main window, menus, preferences, MIDI setup and starts the note/rhythm/score reading games.

tour.title: Core Data Model
tour.description: The musical building blocks: Note, Score, Chord, Interval and Tonality used throughout the exercises.

tour.title: Lesson Loading
tour.description: Lessons.java parses the bundled lesson XML files (SAX) and exposes them to the exercise levels.

tour.title: Exercise Levels
tour.description: The Level interface and its implementations: NoteLevel, ScoreLevel and RhythmLevel drive each exercise type.

tour.title: User Interface
tour.description: Piano provides the on-screen keyboard and ChooseNotePanel lets users pick notes during exercises.

tour.title: MIDI and Audio
tour.description: MidiCommon handles MIDI devices/sequencing and FileTools handles reading/writing lessons, preferences and resources.

tour.title: Configuration and Localization
tour.description: build.xml, settings.properties and the language_*.properties files internationalize the app into 13 languages.

tour.title: Lesson Content
tour.description: Bundled lesson XML files (260 lessons in 13 languages) define the note, rhythm and score exercises, e.g. the English 'An octave on treble clef' lesson.
